notes.en: Bangladeshi HSC alone generally requires a 1-year foundation pathway or 1 year of completed university study in Bangladesh for direct admission at major public universities.
Requires a 4-year Bachelor degree from a recognized university in Bangladesh with a minimum B average / CGPA 2.75.
Level 5/6 Diplomas and Level 7 Graduate Diplomas serve as common bridging options for HSC holders.
Requires strong research proposal and supervisor acceptance. PhD students pay domestic tuition fees in NZ.

moiConditions.en: Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificates from Bangladeshi universities are not accepted by major NZ public institutions.

notes.en: Gaps exceeding 6 months require full documentation (employment experience, tax returns, salary bank statements). Unexplained gaps trigger visa refusals under Genuine Student criteria.

cost.upfrontDepositLabel: Full 1st Year Tuition Fee (Payable after Approval in Principle)

meritThresholdNote.en: Institutional scholarships usually offer flat NZD $5,000--$10,000 fee discounts requiring CGPA 3.5/4.0 or HSC GPA 4.8+.

named.name: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
named.coverage: Full tuition, living allowance, airfare, insurance

named.name: University of Auckland International Student Excellence Scholarship

notes.en: Full scholarships are rare outside MFAT Manaaki NZ government awards and PhD funding. Most university awards are partial tuition waivers.

work.coversWhatShareOfLivingCost: 60% to 80% of living expenses; 0% of tuition fees
work.dependantWorkRights: Full open work rights for partners of Master's (Level 9), PhD (Level 10), or Green List Level 7/8 students; Visitor status only for general Bachelor's.

restrictions.en: 1-year PSWV applies to non-degree Level 7 diplomas unless on the Green List or expanding eligibility criteria.

pathwaySteps: Post Study Work Visa (up to 3 years)
Skilled Employment in ANZSCO Level 1-3 paying median wage
Skilled Migrant Category (SMC) Resident Visa or Green List Straight to Residence

mainRisk.en: Inability to secure an ANZSCO Level 1-3 job paying at or above the official median wage threshold within the 3-year PSWV period.

pr.recentChanges: SMC shifted to a simplified 6-point system where higher qualifications (Level 9 Masters = 5 points) directly accelerate residence eligibility.

visa.name: Fee Paying Student Visa

priorRefusalNote.en: Must be declared. Undisclosed prior refusals result in immediate character refusal under Section 53.

commonRefusalReasons: Unverified source of funds or recent unexplained bank deposits
Failure to meet Genuine Student criteria / weak career progression rationale
Unexplained academic study gaps exceeding 6 months

bangladeshNotes.en: INZ heavily scrutinizes Bangladeshi financial documentation. Use of ANZ Funds Transfer Scheme (FTS) and clean 6-month bank histories is strongly recommended.
